children: On September 23, 2026, the company received notice from NYSE American that it is not in compliance with Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii) due to a stockholders' deficit and multi-year losses. Southland must submit a plan by October 23, 2026 to regain compliance by March 23, 2028. Its common stock and warrants will continue trading on NYSE American under SLND and SLND WS during this period, subject to other listing requirements.
